title: Convergent Dental CEO to Present on Laser Dentistry Innovation
html:
Convergent Dental CEO Robert L. Gershon to Present on Laser Dentistry Innovation for Fifth Consecutive Year

Convergent Dental, the power behind the Solea® All-Tissue Dental Laser, announced its participation in the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference, taking place December 1-3, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace in New York, NY. This invitation-only event will feature more than 400 of the most highly regarded and influential companies across biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, diagnostics, life science tools, healthcare services, wellness, and information technology. It is expected to draw nearly 2,500 attendees, including institutional and private equity investors from the United States, Asia, Europe, and Canada.

Robert L. Gershon, CEO of Convergent Dental, will present on Tuesday, December 1, at 9:30 AM ET. Convergent Dental will also hold in-person, one-on-one meetings with investors and industry professionals that same day, sharing the company’s latest advancements and its vision for driving broad-based adoption of Solea across North America.

“Returning to Piper Sandler for the fifth year in a row is a chance to share the momentum we’re seeing across the Solea community,” said Gershon. “More dentists are recognizing how all-tissue laser technology can elevate the patient experience, efficiency, and clinical care in their practices, and we look forward to discussing what’s next for Convergent Dental with the investment community.”

Investors interested in scheduling a one-on-one meeting with Convergent Dental management should contact their Piper Sandler representative.

About Convergent Dental

Convergent Dental, Inc. (www.convergentdental.com) is a privately owned dental equipment and technology company.

The company’s flagship product, Solea®, is the only CO2 laser cleared by the FDA for all-tissue indications and delivers an anesthesia-free, blood-free, and suture-free experience that dentists and patients can rely on.1

Solea® enables dentists to elevate their practices through improved efficiency, patient experience, clinical effectiveness, and procedural expansion.2

  1. Based on a report of 1,000 procedures performed by Solea users. Documentation on file.
  2. Based on an annual survey of Solea users. Documentation on file.
